title: Pixel Knight vs. the Lava King

meta.scene: PRESS START. The castle gate creaks open.
Lava rising. Jump. Jump. Double jump.
The Lava King rises: phase one.
Dodge the fireballs. Find the pattern.
Phase two: he’s faster now, and angry.
One heart left. The screen flickers. Hold your breath.
Final phase! The sword glows white!
